info.title: Overpay Marketplace API
info.description:
Privacy-focused marketplace API. Buyers browse listings, place orders and
pay with merchant credits (or x402 via the gateway); sellers' bots fulfill
them through the Seller API.

This document is the single source of truth for the API. The Rails test
suite validates every buyer request and response against it, and the SDKs
(owallet-rs/crates/overpay-sdk, and later TypeScript/Python) are built
from it. Change it together with the controllers.

Conventions:
- Successful bodies are wrapped: `{"data": {...}}` for one object,
  `{"data": [...], "next_cursor": "..."|null}` for a page.
- Errors are `{"error": "<human message>", "code": "<machine code>", ...}`.
  Match on `code`, never on the message. Clients must tolerate codes they
  don't know.
- Money fields named `*_cents` are numbers: whole cents are integers, but
  sub-cent prices render as fractions (e.g. `0.25`).

servers.description: Current server (rewritten to the serving host by GET /api/v1/docs)

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Place, pay for and track orders.

tags.name: Merchant Credits
tags.description:
Prepaid credit balances held by a seller or an organization. Credits are
the API's way to pay for an order: `POST /api/v1/orders` with
`pay: "merchant_credits"`, or create then `POST .../redeem`. When a
seller belongs to an organization, redemption draws the buyer's
seller-level balance first, then the organization's.

tags.name: Spend Authorizations
tags.description: Session spending caps across many orders on one metered listing.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Getting an API token — NIP-98 registration or OAuth 2.0 with PKCE.

tags.name: Registration
tags.description: Seller onboarding via NIP-98 Nostr auth.

x-overpay-error-codes-note: components.schemas.ErrorCode lists every `code` the API emits; it is kept equal to ApiErrors::CODES by test/openapi/enum_parity_test.rb.

get.description:
With a Bearer token: the token owner's orders (plus x402 orders settled
by `payer_address`, when given). With NIP-98: the x402 orders of
`payer_address`, which must be an EVM address derived from the signing
key. Passing `ids[]` returns exactly those orders in detail form
(including delivered content) and no cursor.

parameters.name: payer_address
parameters.description: EVM payer address. Required unless authenticated with a Bearer token.

parameters.name: client_session_id
parameters.description: Only orders created with this client_session_id (exact match). An unknown label returns an empty list.

post.summary: Place an order, optionally paying for it with merchant credits
post.description:
`pay: "merchant_credits"` settles the new order in the same request;
the outcome is reported in the top-level `payment` key. A redemption
failure does not fail the create: the order is returned pending.

Metered listings accept a buyer-set `authorization_cents` (within the
listing's bounds) or a `spend_authorization_id`; both require
`pay: "merchant_credits"` and are all-or-nothing — if credits don't
cover them the order is cancelled and the call answers 402
`insufficient_credits`.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe: a retry with the same
key and body replays the first response (marked
`Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of placing a second order.

201.description: The order (and, with `pay`, how paying went)

409.description: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running (`idempotency_request_in_progress`)

get.summary: One order in detail, including delivered or in-progress output
get.description:
Delivered output is inline in `delivered_content`, or — when large or
binary — offloaded: `delivered_content_url` (+ byte size and filename)
instead. While a seller streams, `partial_content`/`partial_seq` carry
the work in progress; pass back the last `partial_seq` you hold as
`since_seq` and an unchanged buffer is omitted.

parameters.name: payer_address
parameters.description: EVM payer address. Required unless authenticated with a Bearer token.

post.summary: Record an order settled on-chain through the x402 gateway
post.description:
Called by the x402 gateway after it settles a payment on-chain; the
order is born paid. This path does NOT consult merchant credits. Not
for buyer clients.

409.description: This settlement transaction was already recorded

get.description:
Authorization-code flow with PKCE (`code_challenge_method=S256`
required). `redirect_uri` must be a loopback address. An optional
`nip98` parameter (a base64 NIP-98 event signing this URL without
`nip98`) links the wallet's Nostr key to the account on approval.

post.description: Mints credits to a buyer. If the calling seller belongs to an organization, the credit is minted on the ORGANIZATION (shared across all member bots), not the individual seller.

amount_cents.description: Amount to mint in USD cents (e.g. 1000 = $10.00)

Aggregate credit stats for the seller

post.summary: Declare an idempotent auto-top-up policy for a buyer
post.description: Ensures the buyer is topped up to target_balance_cents on demand at redemption time, so seller bots never seed balances out-of-band. If the calling seller belongs to an organization, the policy is created at the ORGANIZATION level.

seller_slug.description: Buyer lookup by seller slug, when account_number is absent

target_balance_cents.description: Balance to maintain for the buyer, in USD cents

201.description: Policy upserted. Body: { id, buyer_account_number, buyer_seller_slug, target_balance_cents, holder_type: seller|organization, updated_at }

patch.summary: Reconcile the calling bot's organization membership
patch.description: Idempotently ensures the authenticated seller belongs to the named organization, creating it if needed and moving the seller out of any prior org. Used by bot_manager on every supervisor bootstrap to keep DSL-declared membership in sync.

get.summary: The order's seller log, oldest first
get.description: Append-only entries visible only to the order's seller and moderators, never the buyer.

post.summary: Append to the order's seller log
post.description:
Append-only: entries can't be edited or deleted; a correction is another
entry. A dedup_key already on this order returns that entry (200,
duplicate: true) instead of appending, so retries are safe. data must be
a JSON object of at most 16384 bytes; an order holds at most 500 entries.

200.description: dedup_key matched an existing entry (duplicate: true)

422.description: Validation error (data or note required, bad kind, too large)

get.summary: Every seller-log entry across the seller's orders, newest first
get.description:
For reconciling your own books: each entry carries a summary of its
order's money (authorized/captured cents, seller revenue, platform fee).
Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only entries at or after this time

bearerAuth.description:
API token (64 hex characters) — from `POST /api/v1/buyer/register`,
the OAuth flow, the account page, or (sellers) `POST /api/v1/seller/register`.

nostrAuth.name: Authorization
nostrAuth.description:
NIP-98: `Nostr <base64 kind-27235 event>` with tags `u` (the exact
request URL, query string included) and `method`, signed within 60s.

IdempotentReplayed.description: Present (`true`) when this response is a replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
A unique key per logical request (a UUID is ideal), reused on retries
of that request. Remembered for 24 hours per API user. Reusing a key
with a different request is 422 `idempotency_key_reused`.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's `next_cursor` (empty or absent for the first page).

NotFound.description: No such resource (or not visible to the caller)

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request was understood but can't be carried out

Cents.description: Amount in US cents. Integer for whole cents; fractional for sub-cent amounts.

NullableCents.description: Amount in US cents, or null when not (yet) known.

DecimalString.description: A decimal number rendered as a string (e.g. "500.0").

NextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null on the last page.

Error.description:
Every API error. `code` is the stable machine-readable part; extra
fields depend on the code (see ErrorCode).

error.description: Human-readable message. Don't match on it.

variants.description: unknown_variant — the listing's active variant keys

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. New codes may be added; treat unknown ones as generic failures.

CreditSource.description: Where a credit load came from — a paid load (purchase), a seller's mint or policy top-up (seller_grant), or an admin's grant (admin_grant).

ProviderTool.description: Present when the listing is offered as a model-callable tool under this function name.

JsonSchemaObject.description: A JSON Schema document (opaque to the API).

rate_card.description: Seller-published and opaque to the marketplace.

Listing.description:
A listing. `GET /api/v1/listings` returns the summary fields (with
`description` truncated to 200 characters); `GET /api/v1/listings/{id}`
adds the detail fields.

checkout_url.description: x402 gateway checkout URL for this listing.

checkout_schema.description: Detail only. Schema of the checkout data (e.g. shipping address).

buyer_note_schema.description: Detail only. Schema of the buyer_note; send the note as a JSON string.

delivered_content_schema.description: Detail only. Schema of delivered_content when it is JSON.

variant_field.description: Detail only. The buyer_note key that implies a variant (e.g. "model").

pricing_mode.description: Detail only. `metered` means the price is only the default authorization.

Rejection.description: Why the seller rejected the order (fulfillment_status `rejected`, terminal).

delivered_content_schema.description: Detail only, when the listing declares one.

Order.description:
An order. List responses carry the summary fields; `GET
/api/v1/orders/{id}` (and the list with `ids[]`) add the detail
fields: delivered output (inline or offloaded) and streaming partial
output.

settled_amount_cents.description: What the buyer actually paid after refunds.

authorized_cents.description: What the buyer committed when the order was paid.

captured_cents.description: What the seller finally kept; null until it captures or rejects.

client_session_id.description: The buyer's own opaque label for the session this order belongs to, set at creation. Never shown to the seller.

delivered_content.description: Detail only. The deliverable, inline (absent when offloaded).

delivered_content_url.description: Detail only. Where to download an offloaded deliverable (no auth needed).

partial_seq.description: Detail only, while the seller streams. Sequence of the latest partial chunk.

partial_content.description: Detail only, while the seller streams; omitted when `since_seq` equals `partial_seq`.

buyer_note.description: Free text, or a JSON document encoded as a string (see the listing's buyer_note_schema).

variant.description: An active variant key. Without it, the listing's variant_field in a JSON buyer_note implies one.

spend_authorization_id.description: Size and pay this order from a spend authorization. Requires pay=merchant_credits.

client_session_id.description:
The buyer's own opaque label for the session (conversation, run, job)
this order belongs to; list a session's orders with
`GET /api/v1/orders?client_session_id=`. Never shown to the seller.
Longer than 256 characters, or not a string, is 422
`invalid_client_session_id`.

core.description: True for core marketplace credits (the primary spend balance).

organization.description: Slug of the organization whose balance this is, when the seller is in one.

label.description: Human-readable description: Credit Load, Seller Credit, Admin Credit, Order Payment or Refund.

amount_cents.description: Always positive (to 4 decimal places; micropayments resolve to $0.000001); `type` gives the direction.
USD cents to 4 decimal places (micropayments resolve to $0.000001).

total_usd_cents.description: Rendered as a decimal string (unlike other money fields).

beneficiary_organization.description: Slug of the organization the credits go to, when the seller is in one.

payment_address.description: The seller's USDC address, when the seller has a USDC wallet.

token.description: The new API token. Shown once.

OAuthError.description: RFC 6749 §5.2 error. Not part of the API's `code` scheme.

checkout_schema.description: JSON Schema for post-quote/pre-payment buyer input (e.g. shipping address). May reference marketplace primitives like {"$primitive": "shipping_address:v1"}.

buyer_note_schema.description: JSON Schema for the buyer-note input.

fulfillment_error.description: Why the seller couldn't fulfill, when fulfillment_status is failed

refunded_cents.description: Merchant credits given back on this order

refund_status.description: Credits on a failed or cancelled order are refunded automatically. A metered capture below the authorization reads partial; captured_cents distinguishes it

delivered_content_url.description: Download URL when the deliverable is stored as a file (detail only); delivered_content is then absent

delivered_content_byte_size.description: Size of the file at delivered_content_url (detail only)

delivered_content_filename.description: Filename of the file at delivered_content_url (detail only)

holder_type.description: Whether this balance is held by the caller as a seller or by the caller's organization

SellerLogEntry.description:
One entry in an order's seller log: append-only, readable only by the
order's seller and moderators, never the buyer. kind and data are the
author's; the marketplace stores them but never interprets them.
